applied.action: §1 anchor corrected: the three-card PLX receipt measures 6.21–6.30 GB/s host-staged copy (cuMemcpyPeer, 256 MiB) against a 6.68 GB/s single-card D2H reference, not 6.63–6.68. Dropped 6.63, which is the ocl_pcie_bw figure from physical-modsmd / pcie-subsystemmd on a different four-card rig and appears nowhere in [[readmemd]]. Propagated consistently: the Gen2 x16 bandwidth-table row is now 6.21–6.68 GB/s, the width ratio is 1.68/6.68 = 0.252 (was 1.68/6.63 = 0.253), and the derived x4 busbw band is 0.93–1.07 GB/s (was 0.94–1.07). §1 now agrees with Source Tensions, which already used 6.21–6.30.

Efficiency band corrected from 53–64% to 55–64%: 3.69/6.68 = 55.2% at the low end. The one-way rate in the same clause is now 6.21–6.68 GB/s (host-staged copy band plus the D2H reference) rather than 6.63–6.68. Applied in the same hunk as pair 2.

Dropped [[2026-09-02-cmp170hx-health-gateipynb]] from the 180 W receipt-chain sentence. The note's body is a mis-fetched NCCL all_reduce.cu source dump with no 77.7/76.4/74.6/78.5 per-card figures, no 180 W cap, no ten-minute gpu-burn -tc, no 63 °C peak, no 80 °C stop rule and no 202 TFLOPS comparison. [[readmemd-2]] carries all of it (per-card table, 180 W enforced, 10-minute gpu-burn -tc, peak core 62/56/63/58 °C, 80 °C stop condition), so the sentence now cites only that note.

Split the citation and corrected the characterisation. [[efficient-training-on-multiple-consumer-gpus-with]] now covers only the <4.5% RoundPipe figure; the ~4.2% zero-bubble figure is attributed to [[zero-bubble-pipeline-parallelism]] ('bubble size is reduced to a third of 1F1B's size'). Added the RoundPipe note's own exact formula: 11.1% on (S−1)/(M+S−1) at S=5, M=32, alongside the 12.5% (S−1)/M approximation.

Softened to what the note measures. The 1.81× is TileLang's `mma.sync` fallback path on H800 SXM — a layout-induced fallback inside an SM90 kernel because V is not K-major — not an sm_80 measurement. The sentence now says so explicitly and states that an sm_80 build 'would be slower still' rather than asserting 'possible-but-slow' from a Hopper number.

Added [[published-as-a-conference-paper-at-colm-2026]] after '3.5× the kernel it feeds'. That note carries the measurement (5.6 ms indexer vs 1.6 ms Sparse MLA at 64K on A100); [[dsa_referencepy]] is retained only for the distillation mechanism it actually supports.

Reframed the MoBA loss clause as what the note contains: fitted 32K trailing-loss scaling-law coefficients (1.546·C^−0.108 against 1.464·C^−0.097) that sit above full attention's in all five runs — not trailing LM-loss values at 32K. The GitHub note keeps only the flash-attn==2.6.3 pin.

Re-pointed the effect-size range. [[moba-mixture-of-block-attention-for]] contains none of 0.014/0.082/nats/3.5% and was removed from the sentence; the 0.0139-nat figure is in [[conditional-memory-via-scalable-lookup]] and the 0.082-nat figure in [[over-tokenized-transformer-vocabulary-is-generally-worth-scaling]], both now cited.

[[a-hitchhikers-guide-to-scaling-law-estimation]] is retained for the 3.5%-relative restart floor only; the 0.014–0.082 range is now carried by the Engram and OverEncoding notes. Applied in the same hunk as pair 60.

The note is a mis-fetched NCCL AllReduce C source dump; [[readmemd-2]] carries the 180 W cap, the 74.6–78.5 TFLOP/s table, the ten-minute gpu-burn -tc and the 80 °C stop rule. This was the last occurrence of the note in the report — grep confirms zero remain.
